lessons: A source-output budget must be qualified on both exact transport capacity and realistic multi-turn coding envelopes. Exact command copying alone can miss reasoning-length tails exposed by real agent trajectories.

After a real-task max-token truncation, increasing only the output ceiling while holding model, wrapper timeout, parser, and PACTA-MSR method fixed is a clean transport repair; the scientific substrate itself must still be replaced because the original source unit was consumed.
The first larger budget, 32768, passes both panels under the already-qualified 900-second AtomCode ceiling, so 65536 is not executed and no budget shopping occurs.
reopen_condition: Use only a completely new disjoint source/future substrate. The retired ten-pair AtomGit T0 pool remains non-reusable.
